close_reason: Resolved for streaming path: app-level chunked dispatch (split_text_for_streaming, 512-char segments via TTSEngine.infer_stream_chunked) caps arena growth — measured long-doc stream RSS plateau 1120.3 MB @5120 chars/11 segs (ru_maxrss == ps current peak, flat) vs §18 <2 GB budget. ORT SessionOptions confirmed unreachable cleanly (session constructed inside SDK engine). Non-stream infer() full-concat path (~2.5 GB offender) re-scoped into VieNeuTTSApp-8jm. Evidence: git note on 6537f98, track learnings phase04 P1T4/P3T1.
